pairs.registryProposal: reduced-motion-mechanics lists the snapshot-transition tree as what a universal selector misses, and does not list SVG SMIL animate. This viewer had to record that a prefers-reduced-motion duration reset does not cover SMIL and gate it in JS. The engine inventory should name SMIL as its own line.
